mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, u_sender.username AS sender_name, u_getter.username AS getter_name, o.title, o.content, o.type, o.deposit, o.sender_price, o.state, o.user_complete, o.auditor_complete, o.release_datetime, o.end_datetime, o.complete_datetime, o.pay_state, o.deposit_state FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_user u_sender ON o.sender_id = u_sender.user_id LEFT JOIN t_user u_getter ON o.getter_id = u_getter.user_id WHERE o.state = '0' AND o.pay_state = '1' AND (o.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchNum}, '%') OR o.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchNum}, '%') OR u_sender.username=#{searchNum} OR u_getter.username=#{searchNum} OR o.type=#{serachNum} OR o.order_id=#{searchNum}) ORDER BY o.release_datetime DESC

SELECT o.order_id, u_sender.username AS sender_name, u_getter.username AS getter_name, o.title, o.content, o.type, o.deposit, o.sender_price, o.state, o.user_complete, o.auditor_complete, o.release_datetime, o.end_datetime, o.complete_datetime, o.pay_state, o.deposit_state FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_user u_sender ON o.sender_id = u_sender.user_id LEFT JOIN t_user u_getter ON o.getter_id = u_getter.user_id WHERE o.state = '0' AND o.pay_state = '1' ORDER BY o.release_datetime DESC

SELECT o.order_id, u_sender.username AS sender_name, u_getter.username AS getter_name, o.title, o.content, o.type, o.deposit, o.sender_price, o.state, o.user_complete, o.auditor_complete, o.release_datetime, o.end_datetime, o.complete_datetime, o.pay_state, o.deposit_state FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_user u_sender ON o.sender_id = u_sender.user_id LEFT JOIN t_user u_getter ON o.getter_id = u_getter.user_id WHERE order_id=#{orderId}

SELECT o.order_id, u_sender.username AS sender_name, u_getter.username AS getter_name, o.title, o.content, o.type, o.deposit, o.sender_price, o.state, o.user_complete, o.auditor_complete, o.release_datetime, o.end_datetime, o.complete_datetime, o.pay_state, o.deposit_state FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_user u_sender ON o.sender_id = u_sender.user_id LEFT JOIN t_user u_getter ON o.getter_id = u_getter.user_id
AND o.state = #{state}
AND (o.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u_sender.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u_getter.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY o.release_datetime DESC
mapper.update: update t_order set state='1',getter_Id=#{userId} where order_id=#{orderId} and state='0'
update t_order set document_path=#{documentPath},user_complete='1' where order_id=#{orderId} and state='1'
update t_order set state='0',getter_Id=null where order_id=#{orderId} and state='1'
update t_order set state='1', user_complete='0', auditor_complete='0', complete_datetime=null, pay_state='1', update_datetime=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and state='2' and getter_id=#{userId}
